book_title: On a Scale of 1 to 10: One man's journey with Chronic Fatigue Syndrome CFS/ME
author: J.M. Georgesson
book_description: After years of struggling with a mysterious illness, I finally had a diagnosis that made sense and I could see the path to recovery. This is the account of my painful and often lonely journey, for so long lost and wandering, desperately in search of answers.
